title: Curacao Makes History as Smallest Nation Ever to Qualify for FIFA World Cup
detail: Curacao, a small Dutch Caribbean island of roughly 150,000 people, has secured its place in history as the smallest nation ever to qualify for the FIFA World Cup. The 2026 tournament marks an unprecedented milestone for the island nation, which navigated CONCACAF qualifying to earn a spot alongside football giants. Curacao's achievement underscores the expanded 48-team format of World Cup 2026, which opened new pathways for smaller footballing nations to reach the global stage for the first time. The island's qualification has been celebrated across the Caribbean as a triumph for smaller football confederations and developing football nations worldwide.
